brief: Identify the official escalation route after a provider’s complaint response is unresolved.

title.es-MX: Ubica la siguiente vía de queja
title.pt-BR: Ache a próxima via da queixa

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Complaint Escalation"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Ubica la siguiente vía de queja"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Ache a próxima via da queixa"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify the official escalation route after a provider’s complaint response is unresolved.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: An unresolved provider reply is a reason to check the correct official route, keeping the original evidence and response.
instruction.misconception: Every authority handles every product or escalation guarantees a refund without evidence or checking eligibility.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Use an independently verified official route for that provider and issue. Check eligibility, required prior steps and supporting complaint records.
The next route must match the provider and dispute.
The complaint history shows what was raised and answered.
Authorities have defined responsibilities rather than universal coverage.
Required steps and records determine whether the route is usable.
A valid route does not predetermine the decision.
The official assignment identifies the relevant next route.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
